'''DBX-11''' was a [[Mynock Extermination Droid]] assigned to the ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]''. It was programmed by [[Chief engineer/Legends|Chief Engineer]] [[Skolos]] to attack [[Black Team (Mortex)|Black Team]] when they [[Battle for Black Ice|captured]] the vessel.
